title: LoRA / Soup kernel research round 4 — CPU numerical evidence
scope: Original CPU numerical research and source-informed diagnostics; no GPU benchmark, original submission kernel, or official challenge pass.

loss_cache.purpose: CPU numerical prototype only; no GPU benchmark or challenge pass claim
loss_cache.reference_contract: same token-chunked FP16 head projection; FP32 stored H/W; ordinary FP32 CE autograd

gradient_gate.explanation: absolute floor OR both relative gates; nonfinite patterns reported separately

important_limits: CPU FP16 GEMM may use different arithmetic from a T4 Tensor Core GEMM
Comparator deliberately shares token-chunked projection schedule, not original full-shape CUDA projection
No Triton kernel, hardware profiler, full Soup run, or hidden-data evaluation
First-order gradients only; frozen head required
No claim of incremental H saving versus a baseline frozen linear

lora_precision.scope: CPU structural and arithmetic diagnostics only; not CUDA RNG, cuBLAS, Triton, or T4 validation

summary_gates.cpu_backend_caveat: Agreement uses this CPU backend's GEMMs. CUDA RNG, cuBLAS reduction order, and Triton code generation are not tested.

sampler_and_shapes.scope: CPU diagnostics of sampler type and RNG sensitivity, plus public shape counts. None of these orders is asserted to be the actual Soup Trainer order.

prior_illustrative_order_shapes.ordering: length-sorted lower bound; analytical only, not an allowed batch reorder

interpretation: The pinned Soup recording wrapper inherits Sampler, not RandomSampler. Accelerate's isinstance(RandomSampler) seedable conversion does not match it.
Attribute forwarding alone does not change Python isinstance behavior.
An inner RandomSampler with generator=None draws a seed from global CPU RNG when iterated. Added CPU random draws can change order.
The complete Trainer RNG history was not executed. Capture actual row IDs, RNG state, and shapes from an untouched run before claiming exact order.
Compile break-even values are arithmetic examples, not measured compile or GPU times.
